profile.headline: Senior Web Developer | Lifelong Learner & Knowledge Sharer
profile.summary: I am a dynamic technical contributor who approaches all aspects of my career and personal life with a growth mindset.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Led the web development efforts for the company marketing website, while providing project management support for the marketing project pipeline. Directed and mentored contract developers and provided Agile workflow onboarding to new marketing team members.

• Led the development of the company marketing website
• Directed project management for marketing initiatives
• Trained team on various systems and platforms

positions.title: Lead UI Developer
positions.description:
Served as the technical lead for a Boston-based boutique design agency. Facilitated in proposal scoping and project estimates while managing development resources.

• Architected and developed client web solutions
• Aided in project planning and managed contract developers
• Provided documentation and tutorials for clients upon project completion

positions.description: Collaborated with multiple small and medium-sized businesses, offering tailored technical solutions to address their specific needs.
